ruleDefinitions.adjacentStepRule: Progress through neighbouring scale degrees in one direction.
ruleDefinitions.singleDirectionRule: Progress in one pitch direction; skipping scale degrees is allowed.

originalInterpretationWitness.decisiveCase: The skipping-monotone case receives different classifications. The original selected cell does not identify which of these candidate criteria, or another criterion, is intended.

candidateReviews.wholeClaim: Heard-reference pitch reproduction with adjustment and a changed reference.
candidateReviews.limit: A successful echo does not establish classification of a pitch sequence.

candidateReviews.wholeClaim: Own sounded creation, listening and purposeful musical revision.
candidateReviews.limit: A sound piece can satisfy this claim without classifying scale paths.

candidateReviews.wholeClaim: Conventional staff reading, recording, mismatch repair and transfer.
candidateReviews.limit: Written-score decoding is a different operation; it is not automatically a Grade2 listening requirement or proof of the publisher’s intended distinction.

candidateReviews.wholeClaim: Replicate rhythm, keep beat and join repeated sound patterns.
candidateReviews.limit: Rhythm and repetition can remain identical while the pitch path changes.

candidateReviews.wholeClaim: Relate source features and vibration rate to pitch through observation and explanation.
candidateReviews.limit: Acoustic explanation does not settle the musical sequence classification.
